- LeverageLedger + UpstreamChangeset(id, comment, accepted) already in contribution.py — id+comment only, NO usernames structurally.
- SensitivityClass C1..C5, geo_tier_for(); geo_tier==3 (C3/C4/C5) = no geometry published → EXCLUDE from push.
- ContributorRepo (ticket anchor) does NOT exist; contributor persistence is in-memory (LD-F10). Aggregate timing implemented in tasks.onboarding (histogram → count+median, no rows) + api L0 hook (app.state, NOT in append-only row).
- L0 form = POST /v1/curation/submission (api/src/api/curation.py) + web/src/pages/curate/submit.astro (zero-JS).
- No contribution-back web page exists yet — create web/src/pages/contribution-back.astro + data.ts getLeverageMetric().
